tabId.label: Tab id

timeoutSec.hint: 5–600. Fails when no command finishes within this window.
timeoutSec.label: Timeout (sec)

expression.hint: Per-operation expression. For map: 'x.field'. For filter: 'x.value > 0'.
expression.label: Expression

operation.label: Operation
operation.reduceHint: Reduce here is a NUMERIC SUM over the item expression only. For general folds (collect, group-by, dedupe, merge, custom reducer) use the data.aggregate node.

query.hint: The text used for vector search. Supports expressions.
query.label: Query

topK.hint: Number of chunks to return. Default 6.
topK.label: Top K

durationMs.hint: The orchestrator pauses the run for this long before continuing.
durationMs.label: Duration

eventKey.hint: Wake key an external source fires (e.g. the wf_emit_workflow_event agent tool). Empty = a private key scoped to this run and step.
eventKey.label: Event key (optional)

timeoutMs.hint: Give up waiting after this long. 0 = wait until the run is cancelled or times out.
timeoutMs.label: Wait timeout

allowPrivateHosts.hint: Permit private / loopback / link-local targets (SSRF opt-in). Leave off unless you trust the target.
allowPrivateHosts.label: Allow private hosts

extractComponents.hint: Also analyze the page into a component structure (template / style / logic).
extractComponents.label: Extract components

framework.hint: Generate components in this framework from the extracted structure. Implies component extraction.
framework.label: Generate framework code

frameworkHint.hint: Hint the extractor about the page's original framework to improve component boundaries.
frameworkHint.label: Framework hint

maxAssets.hint: Maximum number of assets to download (1–5000).
maxAssets.label: Max assets

maxFileSize.hint: Hard per-file byte cap. Leave empty for the engine default; 0 disables the limit.
maxFileSize.label: Max file size (bytes)

mode.hint: 'Bundle' writes a directory with separated assets; 'single' inlines everything into one self-contained HTML file.
mode.label: Mode

output.hint: Where to write the snapshot. Relative paths resolve under the open workspace; 'single' mode writes a .html file, 'bundle' a directory.
output.label: Output path

pretty.hint: Format the output HTML for readability.
pretty.label: Prettify HTML

webhookBanner.desktopOnly: Desktop only. The webhook receiver runs inside the Tauri sidecar.
webhookBanner.saveFirst: Save the workflow to register the webhook and reveal its URL.

webhookRespond.desktopOnly: Desktop only. Respond is delivered via the Tauri webhook router.

hmacSecret.hint: Verifies the X-Signature-256 header. Leave blank to skip verification.
hmacSecret.label: HMAC secret (optional)

responseTemplate.hint: Optional. Defaults to the workflow run id.
responseTemplate.label: Response body template

status.hint: Only fire for one outcome. "Any" fires on both success and failure.
status.label: Outcome filter

workflowId.hint: The source workflow to watch. Empty fires for every workflow that finishes (this workflow itself is always excluded).
workflowId.label: Source workflow (optional)
